content:
Leah Kim: Heads-up 1:30 PT dry-run on Friday for the EBR with Meridian. Need final slide deck, a one-page ask, and a consolidated risk remediation plan by Thu EOD. Can folks confirm owners?

Omar Singh: I can own the risk remediation slide and the list of open mitigation tasks. Will pull the incident + support ticket examples.

Priya Nair: I'll take the onboarding progress slide and the enablement outcomes. Will include the cohort-specific activation curve and the new onboarding playbook adoption rate. Link: https://drive.redwood/meridian-ebr/v4

Carlos Vega: Demo owner here. Live demo preferred but prepping a short recorded fallback (2m) and a static GIF of key flows. Will QA with staging account. ETA Thu 4pm.

Maya Brooks: I'll draft the exec one-pager with 3 asks: (1) committed capacity for dedicated pool, (2) approval for a targeted success pilot, (3) extended support window. Sharing draft Wed noon.

qbr-bot: Calendar: "Meridian EBR 1:30 PT Dry Run" created. Reminder set 1h before.

Leah Kim: Runbook excerpt (paste) - please ack your tasks: 

``
Run order:
1) Leah - Opening + key ask (4m)
2) Priya - Health & onboarding metrics (7m)
3) Omar - Renewal risk + remediation plan (6m)
4) Carlos - Live demo (8m) / fallback explanation
5) Maya - Exec ask & next steps (3m)
6) Q&A + action capture (12m)

Action list:
- Priya: finalize activation curve + playbook uptake (Thu 10am)
- Omar: assemble mitigation task table + owner contact list (Thu EOD)
- Carlos: upload fallback recording + GIF (Thu 4pm)
- Maya: exec one-pager draft (Wed noon)
- Leah: collect feedback form link and add to closing slide (Thu EOD)
```

Priya Nair: Quick note - onboarding playbook adoption increased after the last update, but feature flags mean cohorts vary. I'll annotate slide with cohort boundaries.

Omar Singh: For the remediation table I'm adding severity, impact, owner, eta. Flagging one item as blocker: SSO token refresh edge-case. Need eng support to ETA. @Carlos can you loop infra?

Carlos Vega: Looping infra now. Also checking demo account for SSO jitter. If infra needs more time we switch to recorded demo + product screenshots.

Maya Brooks: For the exec ask, keep the wording tight. Add $$ estimates for committed capacity and an expected delta in latency. I'll work with Finance to get numbers by Wed afternoon.

Leah Kim: Feedback capture: we'll include a short Typeform at the end for execs and product leads. I'll post link once ready. Also planning to tag action items in the product board.

qbr-bot: Runbook created: /runbooks/meridian-ebr-1843210000.md

Omar Singh: Small content change request - replace "at-risk" label with a numeric risk score (1-10) for clarity. Thoughts?

Priya Nair: I support numeric score. Easier for execs to parse. I'll show both score + top driver on the slide.

Carlos Vega: All good. Demo fallback checklist added to the runbook: confirm GIF, mp4, demo notes, and slide showing expected outputs.

Maya Brooks: Draft one-pager uploaded: https://drive.redwood/meridian-ebr/one-pager-draft.docx. Please leave inline comments.

Leah Kim: Final ask - everyone mark done in the runbook and add any outstanding blockers. If all green, we'll do a full-team dry run Fri 1:30 PT and a leadership slice at 3:30 for exec alignment. :rocket:
